item.title: Gunsmoke - Sanctuary
item.description: A bank robber takes refuge in a church, holding the pastor and two women hostage.

item.title: The Waltons - The Bequest
item.description: The promise of inherited money is behind some happy moments and unusual conflicts for the Walton Family.

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - Joker's Wild, Man, Wild!, The
item.description: Two young men play an increasingly dangerous and deadly game for the attentions of a beautiful but spoiled heiress, who plays them off against each other.

item.title: Matlock - Affair, The (aka The Maid)
item.description: Matlock represents a maid accused of killing her employer at the request of the man's widow. The request is a little odd, but it seems the widow wants everyone to know exactly what kind of man her husband was.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Mystified Miner
item.description: Mason tries to clear his young, beautiful client after a twisting and wheeling plot of murder, kidnapping and embezzlement unfolds.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Beaver Joins Record Club
item.description: "Beaver wants to join a record club and asks Ward for the money to join. Fed up with Beaver constantly asking for money, Ward decides to put him on an allowance. However, Beaver is so thrilled with his records he disreguards the bills for them and quickly finds himself swamped with records, a rising bill and not enough allowance to pay for everything."

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Double Date
item.description: Wally's new girlfriend, Carolyn, can't go out to the movies on Saturday night because she has to watch her little sister, Susan. Carolyn suggests that Beaver take Susan out to the movies and that they all double date. Not wanting to let Wally down, Beaver decides to go along, despite being nervous.

item.title: Toon In With Me - Black History in Visual Art
item.description: Toon In With Me - Black History in Visual Art

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 165: Once a Cop
item.description: The search for a stabbing suspect leads to a bitter ex-cop who has just moved into the area. Afterward, Malloy and Reed deal with a naive and frustrated starlet who shoots up a telephone booth and loses her suitcase containing a live rattle snake. The officers then become involved in shootout at a train station that leads to another unfortunate run-in with the ex-cop.

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 36: Man Between
item.description: Officer Reed, who is an optimist and still has faith in the human race, is subjected to ridicule from Officer Wells after he is swindled twice. On patrol, he and Malloy come to the aid of a woman whose baby has been kidnapped by a heavily armed man seeking a large ransom. Afterward, wells once again questions Reed's judgment during the search for an intoxicated sniper at large.
